heading: Annotations
frameSelectTitle: Drag a box in the preview to mark the area to change
empty: No annotations yet — box-select the area to change in the preview
submitConflict: There's already an unfinished submission group — save or cancel it before submitting
interruptedDesc: Last time, the AI was interrupted halfway through these annotations. “Resume” switches back to the original conversation and continues on the current draft; “Revert to before” returns to the state before submission.
narrativeEditing: Aligning the narrative on the latest content based on your edits — changes may span multiple pages.
narrativeDone: Changes may span multiple pages — click “Compare” to review. This submission had no box annotations.
residual_one: The AI still reports {{count}} factual issue — click “Compare” to verify, or “Cancel” to revert
residual_other: The AI still reports {{count}} factual issues — click “Compare” to verify, or “Cancel” to revert
selectTitle: Click to select/deselect; selected items go out with Submit
